method.elapsed: Sum of awaited render/export calls, including failures; initialization, warm-up, reporting and cleanup excluded. Native CLI includes process startup.
method.png: Browser SVG + shared Chromium canvas PNG conversion unless a prepared native PNG path is available. No image inspection.

excluded.reason: The PNG destination /dev/null was rejected as a nonregular output file. Replaced all SVG and PNG repeats after correcting the documented stdout binding and discard descriptor.

consolidation.note: Retains every repeat. Initial missing-Dart setup block superseded by the complete supplemental six-run group. Merman replacement also supersedes its initial PNG invocation error.

method.elapsed: Sum of awaited public render calls including failures; initialization, warm-ups, IPC and reporting excluded. Native CLI includes per-call process startup.

excluded.reason: The original convenience API swallowed parser exceptions and returned error strings. Replaced the entire repeat group with the exported parseMermaid → computeLayout → renderGraph pipeline so errors propagate. No drawing content was tested.

scoring.davebench: Mean format rank percentile among measured participants: 100 for first, 0 for last. Completion-first ranks retain their timing tie-break. Average the predeclared applicable formats; unmeasured applicable formats remain unknown.
scoring.drawing: Mean applicable-format score: 100 × fully passed cases / fixed planned cases; unresolved assessments preserve uncertainty.
scoring.fidelity: 100 × fully passed upstream test cases / fixed scored population; Trident gaps preserve uncertainty.
scoring.overall: Arithmetic mean of the three benchmark scores. A missing benchmark is neither zero nor omitted; overall rank is withheld.
